picacho.name: Christ of El Picacho
picacho.price_text: Small entry fee, roughly HNL 10–30; check on the day
picacho.hours: Daylight hours; check on the day
picacho.tip: The huge statue sits on a hill above the city. Go on a clear morning for the best views and cooler air.

baleada.name: Baleada
baleada.price_text: About HNL 25–60 each, depending on fillings
baleada.hours: Most baleada stands open early morning and evening
baleada.tip: A thick flour tortilla with beans, cheese and cream. Try one at a busy street stand for breakfast.

min.name: Museum of National Identity (MIN)
min.price_text: Small entry fee, roughly HNL 30–80; check on the day
min.hours: Check on the day; often closed Mondays
min.tip: Good short introduction to Honduran history and culture. Ask if a guide is available.

mercado.name: Mercado Zonal Belén
mercado.price_text: Free to enter; bring small cash for food
mercado.hours: Morning to early evening; check on the day
mercado.tip: Busy local market for fruit, cheese and cheap meals. Keep valuables close and go with a local if you can.

parque-central.name: Parque Central and Cathedral walk
parque-central.tip: Start here for a short walk around the old centre and the cathedral. Go in daylight only.

morazan-walk.name: Boulevard Morazán evening walk
morazan-walk.hours: Best after dark; cafés and restaurants open late
morazan-walk.tip: The main modern strip for cafés and restaurants. Walk it in the evening when it is lively.

guijarro-view.name: Lomas del Guijarro viewpoint
guijarro-view.tip: Hillside neighbourhood with city views and cafés. Take a taxi up and walk down.

valle-angeles-tour.name: Day trip to Valle de Ángeles
valle-angeles-tour.price_text: Roughly HNL 300–800 by taxi or tour; check on the day
valle-angeles-tour.hours: Full day; leave in the morning
valle-angeles-tour.tip: A cool hill town with craft shops and food. Arrange your return ride before you go.

suyapa.name: Basílica de Suyapa
suyapa.hours: Daylight hours; busy on feast days
suyapa.tip: Honduras's main pilgrimage church. Dress modestly and go in daylight.

chiminike.name: Chiminike children's museum
chiminike.price_text: Small entry fee, roughly HNL 40–100; check on the day
chiminike.hours: Check on the day; often closed Mondays
chiminike.tip: Hands-on science and culture museum, good with kids. Confirm opening hours before you go.

cafe-centro.name: Coffee stop in the old centre
cafe-centro.price_text: About HNL 40–100 for coffee and a snack
cafe-centro.tip: Honduran coffee is excellent. Take a break indoors in the centre during the heat of the day.

city-tour.name: Guided city tour by car
city-tour.price_text: Roughly HNL 500–1000 per person; check on the day
city-tour.tip: A driver-guide helps you cover the spread-out city safely. Agree the price and stops first.

pupuseria.name: Pupusería dinner
pupuseria.tip: Cheap, filling and everywhere. Order a few pupusas with curtido and a drink.

parque-naciones.name: Parque Naciones Unidas
parque-naciones.tip: Hillside park with city views and a small open-air theatre. Go in daylight and keep it short.

mercado-morazan.name: Supermarket and food hall stop
mercado-morazan.price_text: Free to enter; pay for what you buy
mercado-morazan.tip: Handy for water, snacks and safe self-catering. Good for stocking up before a day trip.

mirador-taxi.name: Taxi ride to a hill mirador
mirador-taxi.price_text: Roughly HNL 100–200 each way; agree the fare first
mirador-taxi.tip: Use a radio taxi or app and agree the fare before you get in. Go up in daylight.

souvenir-shop.name: Craft and souvenir shops
souvenir-shop.tip: Look for Lenca pottery and coffee to take home. Compare prices in a few shops.

iglesia-los-dolores.name: Iglesia Los Dolores
iglesia-los-dolores.tip: Old church in the centre, a short stop on a centre walk. Go in daylight.
